items.name: InsurAi-Corporate-Policy-Automation-and-Intelligence-System
items.description: InsurAI is an AI-powered system that automates insurance policy management, ensures real-time compliance, and provides instant policy answers — reducing manual work and speeding up decisions.

items.name: true-care
items.description: An AI-powered machine learning application designed to process healthcare reimbursement claims. It analyzes medical documents, client information, insurance policies, and legal regulations to predict accurate reimbursement amounts, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and fraud detection.

items.name: Insurance-compliance-AI-agent
items.description: AI-powered tool that reads, summarizes, and checks compliance of insurance-related documents (PDFs, images, scans).

items.name: Durable-Functions-For-Agentic-Workflows
items.description: A serverless workflow solution for analyzing insurance policies using Azure Durable Functions. This project integrates AI-driven agents, rule-based evaluations, and internet search tools to assess risks, industry trends, and policy compliance, providing a scalable framework for business process automation.

items.name: us-federal-ai-compliance-toolkit
items.description: US Federal AI Compliance Toolkit - OMB M-24-10, NIST AI RMF, CMMC 2.0, and SEC-ready artifacts for GovCon & finance. Reduces regulatory, audit, and insurance risk for rights- and safety-impacting AI systems.

items.name: acord-data-quality-monitor
items.description: AI-Agentic Data Quality Monitor for ACORD Insurance Submissions - Automated validation, enrichment, and compliance checking with 90% AI-generated code from YAML contracts

items.name: MedClaimML
items.description: An AI-powered machine learning application designed to process healthcare reimbursement claims. It analyzes medical documents, client information, insurance policies, and legal regulations to predict accurate reimbursement amounts, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and fraud detection.

items.name: vigil
items.description: A production-ready, multi-agent AI system designed to automate email compliance monitoring for the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) sector. This system leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) and advanced orchestration to detect policy violations, security risks, and anomalous communication patterns at scale.

items.name: Florida-AI-Insurance-Compliance-Auditor-HB-527-
items.description: As a Florida 2-15 Licensed professional, I identified a gap in how insurers are using LLMs. This tool automates the audit of AI-generated quotes to ensure compliance with FL HB 527 and SEC/FINRA standards. It prevents 'Solely-Automated' denials and flags illegal marketing language.

items.name: Insurance-Advisor-Compliance-Agent
items.description: An AI-powered Insurance Advisor and Compliance Agent helping users choose the right insurance, understand their existing policies, detect coverage gaps, and stay IRDAI compliant.
